_comment: SAM-Road (htcr/sam_road, MIT) — road graph extraction. First run downloads SAM ViT-B (~375 MB) and the trained SAM-Road checkpoint from HuggingFace into ./tmp/weights. The cityscale checkpoint was trained on ~1 m/px aerial imagery; if your raster is higher-res, set source_gsd_m_per_px so it gets resampled. Lowered thresholds vs upstream defaults for higher recall on out-of-distribution imagery.

kwargs._comment: source_gsd_m_per_px is auto-detected from the raster transform; override only if the raster is mis-georeferenced.
